name: Walker S1
name_zh: Walker S1 工业���形机器人
summary:
Walker S1 is UBTECH's industrial humanoid platform combining task planning with learned whole-body control. Its software is designed to interpret task intent and coordinate actions, while semantic visual navigation combines scene understanding with localization and mapping.

The platform targets variable manufacturing environments where a robot must move, perceive objects and manipulate them as part of a workflow. UBTECH describes an integrated perception-and-control approach for learning motion behavior. These features are intended to reduce the separation between navigation and physical work

description.en:
Walker S1 is UBTECH's industrial humanoid platform combining task planning with learned whole-body control. Its software is designed to interpret task intent and coordinate actions, while semantic visual navigation combines scene understanding with localization and mapping.

The platform targets variable manufacturing environments where a robot must move, perceive objects and manipulate them as part of a workflow. UBTECH describes an integrated perception-and-control approach for learning motion behavior. These features are intended to reduce the separation between navigation and physical work, with practical deployment still depending on task training, tooling and integration with the production process.
